senses.gloss:
गगण गगण, अम्, n. (often spelt गगन;
perhaps fr. ग-गण, ‘containing troops of moving
beings?’ said to be for गमन fr. rt. गम्, to go),
the atmosphere, air; the sky, heaven, the firmament;
talc.
—गगण-कुसुम, अम्, n., see गगण-पुष्-
प.
—गगण-गञ्ज, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—गगण-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, moving in the air, an
inhabitant of the sky.
—गगण-चर, अस्, m. moving
in the air, a bird; [cf. गगणे-चर.]
—गगण-
ध्वज, अस्, m. the sun; a cloud.
—गगण-पुष्प,
अम्, n. a flower in the sky, i. e. any unreal or fanciful
thing, an impossibility; [cf. ख-पुष्प.]
—ग-
गण-प्रिय, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava.
—गगण-
मूर्धन्, आ, m., N. of a Dānava.
—गगण-विहा-
रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, moving or sporting in the sky; (ई),
m. a heavenly luminary; the sun; a celestial being
or divinity.
—गगण-सद्, त्, त्, त्, abiding in the air;
(त्), m. an inhabitant of the air, a celestial being.
—गगण-स्थ or गगण-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, situ-
ated or being in the sky.
—गगण-स्पर्शन, अस्,
m. touching the sky; N. of one of the eight Maruts;
[]
air, wind.
—गगणाग्र (˚ण-अग्˚), अम्, n. the
highest heavens, the summit or highest part of
heaven.
—गगणाङ्गना (˚ण-अङ्˚), f., N. of a
metre, containing four lines of twenty-five syllabic
instants each.
—गगणाध्वग (˚ण-अध्˚), अस्, m.
the sun; a planet; a celestial spirit.
—गगणाम्बु
(˚ण-अम्˚), उ, n. rain-water.
—गगणे-चर, अस्, आ,
अम्, going in the air; (अस्), m. a bird; a planet;
a lunar mansion; a heavenly spirit; [cf. गगण-
चर.]
—गगणोल्मुक (˚ण-उल्˚), अस्, m. the planet
Mars.

गग्घ् गग्घ्, cl. 1. P. गग्घति, to laugh,
laugh at or deride; [cf. कख्.]

गग्नु गग्नु, a various reading for वग्नु,
‘speech.’

गागनायस गागनायस, अम्, n. (fr. गगन
+ अयस्), meteoric iron (?).
